mission_prompt: Ingest uploaded government cloud migration RFP, extract mandatory technical compliance criteria, model multi-tier labor pricing, and generate a winning executive proposal with compliance traceability matrix.

units.task_name: Ingest and Parse RFP Document into Structured Data
units.description: Load the uploaded government cloud migration RFP (PDF/Word), extract text, and convert it into a structured tabular format suitable for downstream analysis. Identify sections such as Technical Requirements, Compliance Standards, Evaluation Criteria, and any embedded tables.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [None - Initial Branch Node]
units.output_contract: A JSON or CSV representation of the RFP text with identified section headers and extracted tables.

units.description: From the parsed RFP data, identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, performance SLAs, audit requirements). Classify each criterion by category and note any referenced standards or regulations.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A list of mandatory compliance criteria with categories, reference IDs, and brief descriptions.

units.description: Using the extracted criteria and typical government procurement pricing models, construct a multi‑tier labor cost table (e.g., Tier 1: Senior Cloud Engineer, Tier 2: Mid‑level Architect, Tier 3: Support Technician). Include hourly rates, estimated effort per compliance item, and total projected costs.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A structured pricing table with labor tiers, rates, effort estimates, and aggregated cost totals.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Compose a polished executive proposal that (1) summarizes the solution approach, (2) presents the multi‑tier pricing model, and (3) includes a traceability matrix linking each mandatory compliance criterion to the proposed labor tier(s) responsible for meeting it. Format the output as a structured document (e.g., Markdown or Word outline).
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t3]
units.output_contract: A complete executive proposal document with sections, pricing tables, and a compliance traceability matrix.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP, including extraction of mandatory technical compliance criteria, modeling of multi‑tier labor pricing, and generation of a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The request requires ingesting an uploaded document, extracting structured requirements, performing quantitative modeling, and producing a deliverable. This maps to a four‑phase pipeline: ingestion & parsing, requirement extraction, pricing model construction, and proposal synthesis with traceability.
